_doc: The per-stage head table of the packets (G-RENDER, test/shiploop_e2e/render_diff.py): the longest printed text each stage may have, in characters, by case, route, run-directory length and CLI path length (the key 'inline/83/96' is route/run directory/CLI path). render_diff exits non-zero when a stage prints more than its value here or has none. A value changes in the commit that journals the new value (the plan's U1 re-baselines it for the merged branches, U7 sets the allocation); no other unit raises it. The first values are main da9e2e75 (skill-craft 2.5.0 / ShipLoop 1.5.0) rendered by packets.py --offline --text-dir and written by render_diff.py --emit-table DIR --write; they are ceilings, not targets, and a stage over the 20,000-character host cut is journaled as such, not hidden here. Re-written 2026-10-17 by packet-review U3/U4 (feat/pr-u3-head-1b7a72) with render_diff.py --emit-table --write on the four renders: the head prints the guides its duties cite and the Backchain lines with the text that cites them (up to +1,200, carry-forward), the one-line pass, floor and ratchet rules (-172 at test and verify); every printed text stays under 20,000 at 83 and 163. Re-written 2026-10-17 by packet-review wave 2 W2-A/W2-B (feat/pr-w2-proof-75e8ad) with render_diff.py --emit-table --write on the four renders: step-plan asks each step for its check, the Proof implement runs at done (step-plan whole +581 inline, +699 ask-agent), and implement's exit conditions name the step's criteria and Proof (+212 inline, +120 ask-agent); every printed text stays under 20,000 at 83 and 163. Re-written 2026-11-01 for step-plan only, from render_diff.py --emit-table on the four renders of the focused-ID rule (docs/shiploop-step-plan-review-2026-11-01.md): +78 on each key, +40 of it this change (duty 5 'an ID for each criterion it names', Checked-by 'or lacks an ID per criterion') and +38 from 8dee00e0's duty 6 sentence, which head_table.json journaled but this table did not; inline/83/96 19,966, inline/163/96 19,332, ask-agent/83/96 18,832, ask-agent/163/96 19,872. The same renders put the test stage 3 under its value here; that is left as it was. Re-written 2026-11-01 for step-plan only (render_diff.py --emit-table on the four renders): +9 per key for duty 5's 'an ID for each executed criterion it names'. Re-measured 2026-11-05 for step-plan after ca9b202bb8cdf018ff29799984190abcb7790217, using the same four fixed-text renders before and after: the primary UI-selection duty adds 233 characters and the direct visual guide adds 82 to whole packets. New printed step-plan sizes are inline/83 19,786, inline/163 19,574, ask-agent/83 19,074 and ask-agent/163 19,721; smaller heads can result when an optional block no longer fits. The hard 20,000 cut is unchanged; all four renders fit. Other stages and historical entries are untouched. Evidence: packet-cost-transfer-01 in the 2026-11-05 UI prompt experiment. Re-measured 2026-11-05 for explicit criterion content and the existing unconfirmable open-item route: final step-plan text grows 126 characters. Printed sizes inline/83 19,912; inline/163 19,700; ask-agent/83 19,200; ask-agent/163 19,847. All packets in generic and full interaction walks fit both measured paths/routes. Earlier 162- and 149-character drafts crossed the cut in interaction steps; retained as adverse evidence. No hard cut or quality floor changes. Evidence: packet-cost-criterion-content-01 through -03. Journaled 2026-11-12 on the merge of step-plan round 2 (stepplan2-cf7d87: A1, A2a, D) into main c5c59da6: values kept as main had them, since packets now print whole and the table is historical evidence that the packet-recut, step-packets, render-diff and handoff suites still pass on; the merge's measured change to the printed packets of offline node-fix-bug at run dir 83 and CLI path 96 (inline) is step-plan -20 (A2a's Proof bullet 'reruns it at the step's done, so make it safe to repeat', paid for by trimming the tests-are-not-a-step clause) and test-spec +54 (D: RED may be 'because the code this item adds does not load yet'), no other line.
